value.selftest_output:
FIX: run_m4.py: item 5 (parsers raise ValueError on malformed input): a prediction log that reports an error is malformed, so parse_colabfold_log raises instead of returning empty timings (test parse_colabfold_log).
FIX: run_m4.py: items 4 and 7 (a capability-check problem is exit 2 with a void record): the capability stage now fails when nvidia-smi lists no graphics processor (test stage_fails_on_malformed_nvidia_smi).
FIX: run_m4.py: items 5, 7 and 21 (the closing stage reads the rows and exits 2 on malformed ones): a truncated rows file now reaches the rows parser and exits 2; the stage no longer skips an input whose record exists only in the inputs directory (test stage_fails_on_malformed_af2_rows).
FIX: run_m4.py: item 15 (one dynamics segment per complex): the segment summary is read with every field optional and the reporter file is found by name or by pattern, so one production call per complex completes (test md_calls_kept_apart).
FIX: run_m4.py: item 24 (a stop leaves its unfinished inputs unmeasured_by_stop): after a guard, ceiling or timeout stop, every input never reached is marked unmeasured_by_stop with the stop kind (test guard_stops_by_time).
FIX: run_m4.py: item 11 (run_valid_voided_by carries the anchor's text): later stages take the voiding text from the anchor record itself, not a paraphrase (test after_miss_every_later_record_invalid).
FIX: run_m4.py: items 11, 12 and 21 (every input gets a record after an anchor miss, decided by its own checks): the closing stage writes each input record from the rows even when a stale record sits in the inputs directory (test after_miss_calibration_by_own_checks).
FIX: run_m4.py: items 11 and 12 (one failing check of a record stays that record's own reason): the same record-writing fix; the raw value is kept and the record is VOID by its failed check (test after_miss_own_check_failure_stays_own).
FIX: run_m4.py: items 12 and 21 (the dynamics checks read the planted rows): the same record-writing fix; the closing stage writes the records it decides (test md_reporter_nan_and_atoms_calibration).
FIX: run_m4.py: item 21 (one record per input in the results directory): the closing stage writes each input record under the output directory whenever that directory holds none (test records_endpoints).
FIX: run_m4.py: item 21 (raw rows per dynamics segment): the dynamics stage no longer crashes on a worker summary that names no reporter file, so the rows file is written (test records_rows).
FIX: run_m4.py: items 3 and 7 (a lock mismatch is exit 2 with a void record): the capability stage exits 2 when the observed lock differs from the forwarded one (test records_env_check_and_lock).
FIX: run_m4.py: stage interface (a stage writes only under the output directory): downloads of a stage invocation land under that directory, not in the payload data directory (test writes_only_under_out).
value.expected: Projected wall-clock on one box, from the binding ceilings. Environment activation and its lock hash about 60 s; capability probes about 120 s; structure file and parameter archive about 300 s including unpacking; setup total 1,500 s shared. Planted 60 s sleep, empty run and unit record about 70 s; redocking anchor, serial then parallel, plus diagnostics about 400 s; the two share 1,000 s. Per-pair docking and interface analysis 600 s ceiling, at most 250 s per pair, 3 pairs. Prediction timings 2,000 s ceiling: 1 to 9 runs of 120 s to 1,800 s; a decision needs 3 completed runs over 3 pairs. Dynamics 1,600 s ceiling, at most 600 s per complex, 2 to 3 complexes. Storage 20 s to 100 s. Closing stage 100 s. Margin 400 s. Ceilings sum to 7,200 s. Record counts at full sample: 4 input records (prediction hours, dynamics speed, auxiliary hours, storage), 1 anchor record, 3 control records (sleep, empty run, unit and scale), 1 environment-check record: 9 records. Row lines: 9 prediction runs (3 pairs by 3 seeds), 2 anchor rows, 3 docking rows, 3 dynamics rows, 3 storage rows, 2 control rows: 21 lines. Evidence: 3 pair structures, 3 sequence files, 1 pair-evidence file, 2 anchor rank tables and kept poses, 3 pair rank tables and kept poses, 1 byte-for-byte copy of the published structure. Closing files: 1 summary whose first key is the run's scope and which holds the compute table of 9 stage entries, 1 validity file, 1 done marker with one status per input, 1 environment note, 1 compute table, plus tool logs.
